curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Is David truly the ideal partner he pretends to be, or is a dangerous secret lurking behind his helpful smile?
curatedMovie.description: Returning from military school, Michael Harding discovers his mother living happily with her new boyfriend, David. But as they share the house, David's excessively helpful demeanor begins to trigger deep suspicion.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful horror-thriller pairing suburban unease with moderate emotional stakes for an engaged solo watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Nelson McCormick delivers a taut domestic thriller centered on the quiet, claustrophobic dread of wondering whether a mother's new partner is harboring a sinister side.
